svg.title: The rules' cost per scheduler step
svg.desc: The wall time of one call of vLLM 0.32.0's Scheduler.schedule() on the host's CPU in each state, on a log scale whose second axis is the box's CPU, 1.62 times as long, beside the box's steps (a voice reply's alone, 12 ms; beside held agent prefill, 16 to 20 ms; the agents' at 24 agent sessions, 38 ms), for stock vLLM, the change with its switches off (within 4.4% of stock's in every state) and the configuration to deploy (its change to the step from −32 to +1,473 µs): only lower-priority work, 16 running: 322, 326 and 380 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running: 800, 802 and 883 µs; only lower-priority work, 256 running: 2,611, 2,621 and 2,772 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,602, 1,608 and 1,645 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, no prefix hit: 701, 703 and 736 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 16 running: 321, 325 and 644 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running: 827, 836 and 1,197 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running: 2,681, 2,688 and 3,148 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running, 10 waiting: 2,652, 2,666 and 3,103 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,553, 1,555 and 3,028 µs; every running slot taken, 16 running: 178, 181 and 332 µs; every running slot taken, 64 running: 654, 656 and 833 µs; every running slot taken, 256 running: 2,467, 2,478 and 2,715 µs; in the serving profile, only agents, 2 running: 66, 69 and 86 µs; in the serving profile, a reply's first tokens, an agent waiting that fits, 2 running: 118, 121 and 89 µs; in the serving profile, a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 16 running: 232, 235 and 318 µs; in the serving profile, the step that preempts for a waiting turn, 2 running: 189, 197 and 662 µs.
